messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder and params. We need to construct params as an array containing booleans: includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true. Also we might need to set other parameters like includeDynamicTemplates? But question says "includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection". That likely means we want to include defaults for those features. So includeDefaults true will include all default settings. skipRuntimeFields true will skip runtime fields.

Thus we call functions.RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder: "xContentBuilderInstance" (string) and params: "[true, true]".

But the function expects params as string representation of Java ArrayList type. So we pass something like "java.util.ArrayList[true, true]"? In earlier examples, they passed "[true, false]" etc. So we can pass "[true, true]".

Thus output: { "name": "RootObjectMapper.doXContent", "arguments": {"builder":"xContentBuilderInstance","params":"[true,true]"} }

Let's produce that.
